fix: The listener runs on every editor notification, including caret and selection moves, and `editor.value()` clones the whole text each time. Read the value borrowed with `inner.editor.with_value(|value| ...)` (incular-text editing.rs:409) and have `record` take `&TextEditingValue`. Compare text on the borrowed value. Clone `value.text` only when the text actually changed. On selection-only change, copy the fields: `history.current.selection = value.selection; history.current.composing = value.composing;`. Keep `sync_state()` outside the `with_value` closure so a listener that edits the editor cannot hit a RefCell borrow conflict. Check that `with_value` is re-entrancy safe before relying on it.

The checklist forbids `std::thread` in code reachable on wasm32, and this Drop impl is in shared runtime code. Replace the unwind check with an explicit flag. Add `completed: bool` to `RestorePrevious`, set `guard.completed = true` right after `self.editor.set_value(value)`, and in Drop call `self.inner.sync_state()` only `if self.completed`. Behavior is the same: state is not synced while unwinding.
`initial` is not used after this point and `Rc::new_cyclic` takes an FnOnce, so move it instead of cloning: `current: initial,`.

Once the history is full, every committed edit removes the oldest step from the front of a Vec, which shifts the remaining entries. Store `undo` and `redo` as `VecDeque<Step>`, then use `pop_front()` while `len() > max_entries`. `pop_back`/`push_back` replace the current `pop`/`push`, and the rest of the logic stays the same.
